prompt:

Composition: Show one green shield-shaped true bug (a stink bug) in a clear top three-quarter view. Six short jointed legs connected to the thorax, two antennae, folded forewings with a small central triangular scutellum. No ladybird spots, no beetle horns.

Style: Use the attached invidious.png for drawing style only. Match its thick rounded dark-brown outlines, rounded simplified forms, and restrained 2D cartoon shading. Do not copy the reference subject or composition.

Framing: Make a single compact composition with the main subject filling about 80-90% of the square. Keep the subject large, close, and fully inside the frame.

Output: 512x512 PNG, RGBA, transparent background. No text, letters, labels, speech bubbles, borders, logos, or watermark.
EDIT: Correct only the leg count of this green shield bug. It currently shows only five legs. Add one matching short jointed hind leg on the viewer's lower-right side of the body, so there are exactly six clearly visible legs, three on each side. Keep exactly two antennae, the same body, wing details, thick brown outline, colors, transparent background and composition. No text.
en: A green bug has a shield-shaped body, six legs, and two antennae.
ja: 盾のような形の緑色の虫に、6本の脚と2本の触角があります。
